mapper.sql: s.settlement_id, s.application_id, s.item_code, c.code_name AS item_name, s.expense_date, s.vendor_name, s.supply_amount, s.vat_amount, s.total_amount, s.description, s.receipt_file_id, f.original_name AS receipt_file_name, s.status, s.reject_reason, s.reviewed_by, s.reviewed_at, s.created_at
FROM settlement s LEFT JOIN com_code_detail c ON s.item_code = c.code_id AND c.group_id = 'EXP_ITEM' LEFT JOIN com_file f ON s.receipt_file_id = f.file_id
mapper.update: UPDATE settlement SET status = #{status}, reject_reason = #{rejectReason}, reviewed_by = #{reviewedBy}, reviewed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'REQUESTED'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM settlement WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status = 'APPROVED'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM settlement WHERE application_id = #{applicationId} AND status IN ('APPROVED', 'REQUESTED')
